correctness.rationale: The complete spectral projector calculation gives every matrix entry for every N and eta. Taking logarithms of within-part entries yields a scalar integral average; its strictly increasing integrand proves a unique positive sign crossing. Its strict decrease with part fraction proves largest-part dominance. Coupling optimization is exactly x minus the integral of this increasing function, whose derivative crosses zero once at the stated logarithm. The explicit maximal value and both limits follow by substitution and elementary expansions. The standalone independent matrix-exponential checker passed 19,560 entry comparisons, 1,152 coupling/ordering tests, and 16 limit tests; these supplement, not replace, the universal proof.

value.rationale: The exact transient sign-recovery horizon is a natural measure of loss of positivity for mixed second-/fourth-order diffusion. A global parameter optimization, strict multipartition shape comparison, and finite universal star-to-near-clique optimized gap expose graph design structure not given by the pure fourth-order or star formulas.
